item.title: Vietnam: AI and Cloud Fuel Data Centre Investment Boom
item.description: Ho Chi Minh City is rapidly emerging as a leading regional hub for billion-dollar hyperscale data centre investments, driven by AI adoption, cloud demand and strong government support for digital infrastructure.

item.title: Hong Kong: SMEs Embrace AI, Digital Tools Amid Caution
item.description: Hong Kong SMEs remain cautiously optimistic in early 2026, investing steadily in technology and AI to enhance productivity, digital transformation and navigate rising costs amid uneven sectoral conditions.

item.title: India: Developing Next-Generation Chip Design Talent
item.description: India’s Chips to Start-up Programme is accelerating domestic semiconductor design by training thousands, enabling startups and building a skilled, industry-ready workforce for a competitive innovation ecosystem.

item.title: Singapore: Tech and Training Shape the Future of Healthcare
item.description: Singapore is actively leveraging technology, AI and flexible workforce training to transform healthcare delivery, ensuring high-quality patient-centred care while preparing professionals for a digital future.

item.title: Malaysia: Selangor to Pilot AI-Powered Safety Monitoring for Elderly
item.description: Selangor is launching a pilot AI-powered monitoring system using sensors to enhance safety, health, well-being and independence for older residents in homes and care centres.

item.title: Australia: CQUniversity Uses AI for Smarter Cricket Fielding Analysis
item.description: CQUniversity is developing a real-time computer vision and AI system to automatically track, analyse and optimise cricket fielding formations.

item.title: The Philippines: Free Connectivity to Bridge the Digital Divide
item.description: The DICT–NIR’s Bayanihan SIM Project provides free mobile data to students and teachers in Negros Occidental, helping bridge the digital divide and support inclusive, equitable access to online learning.

item.title: Hong Kong: Empowering Smart Semiconductor Manufacturing
item.description: Hong Kong’s Innovation and Technology Commission has approved a NIAS-backed project to develop local semiconductor equipment production, boosting advanced manufacturing, smart production and high-tech capabilities.

item.title: Vietnam: Science, Tech and Innovation for Next-Gen Growth
item.description: Vietnam aims to drive sustainable, high-value economic growth by placing science, technology, innovation, digital transformation and strategic research partnerships at the core of its development strategy.

item.title: Singapore: Genomic Centre Pioneers Predictive Healthcare
item.description: Singapore’s new SingHealth Genomic Assessment Centre leverages genomics and advanced data analytics to enable predictive, personalised and digitally driven healthcare nationwide, with future AI integration under study.
